Traveller Shed made my Himalayan trip truly unforgettable. I traveled across Spiti (Kaza), Tabo, Key Monastery, Chicham, Dhankar Monastery, Kunzum Pass, Bir Billing, Rajgundha, and Jibhi, and everything—from stays to itinerary—was perfectly arranged.

I recently booked the Spiti Full Circuit with The Travellers Shed, and despite having to cut my trip short due to health issues, my experience with them was nothing short of exceptional.
Our driver, Rajat bhai, was incredible. He was highly experienced, handled the difficult terrain with ease, and made the journey both comfortable and adventurous. The accommodations provided were far better than expected! truly top-notch!!
What impressed me most, however, was the support I received when I had to descend from Kaza unexpectedly. Ashu, Kunal, and Nikhil were lifesavers. They provided full support, and their local partners went above and beyond to ensure I reached the hospital and handled all the formalities.
It speaks volumes about their professionalism and care for their travelers. I couldn’t complete the circuit this time, but I know for a fact that whenever I do, it will be with The Traveller Shed. Highly recommended!
